Terms of Service

AB OUTREACH · WEBSITE TERMS · INDIA + INTERNATIONAL PROJECTS
Important: These website terms are a practical business template, not a substitute for a lawyer-reviewed contract. For higher-value, regulated, cross-border or unusual projects, the signed project agreement should contain the project-specific legal terms.

1. Agreement and scope

These Terms of Service govern website design, development, maintenance and related digital services supplied by AB OUTREACH. A project-specific quotation, proposal, statement of work or signed agreement may add, replace or clarify terms for that project. If there is a conflict, the signed project agreement controls to the extent stated in that agreement.

2. No automatic time or delivery guarantee

Any date, duration, turnaround estimate or launch target communicated before or during a project is an estimate only unless a written project agreement expressly states that a date is binding. AB OUTREACH does not promise that every project will be completed by a particular date. Delivery may be delayed by revisions, late feedback, missing content, approval delays, payment delays, third-party services, technical issues, force majeure or other circumstances outside AB OUTREACH’s reasonable control. Delays do not by themselves create a refund, penalty or right to withhold unrelated amounts unless required by the applicable written agreement or law.

3. Scope, revisions and change requests

Only the services and deliverables expressly included in the agreed scope are included in the project fee. New pages, features, integrations, copywriting, photography, branding, migrations, additional revisions or other material changes may require a revised quote and may affect the project schedule. AB OUTREACH may pause work on a changed scope until the revised scope and price are accepted.

4. Client responsibilities

The client must provide accurate information, approved content, brand assets, access credentials and decisions reasonably required for the project. AB OUTREACH is not responsible for delays or defects caused by inaccurate, incomplete or late client-provided materials or instructions. The client is responsible for ensuring that materials supplied to AB OUTREACH may legally be used.

5. Fees, payment and taxes

Payment terms are set in the project proposal or invoice. Work may be paused if an undisputed payment becomes overdue. Unless expressly stated otherwise, government taxes, GST where applicable, payment-processor charges, bank charges, foreign-exchange costs and similar transaction costs are handled as stated on the invoice or project agreement. For international clients, the client is responsible for any taxes or withholding obligations imposed on the client in its jurisdiction, subject to applicable law and proper tax documentation.

6. Refunds and cancellation

Refunds, if any, are governed by the applicable project agreement and mandatory law. Amounts relating to work already performed, approved deliverables, non-cancellable third-party purchases or committed project costs may remain payable. If a project is cancelled, AB OUTREACH may invoice for completed work and approved or unavoidable costs, to the extent permitted by law.

7. Intellectual property

Unless the project agreement says otherwise, final custom deliverables specifically created for the client are transferred or licensed to the client only after full payment of all amounts due for those deliverables. AB OUTREACH retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, methods, reusable components, know-how, frameworks and generic development techniques. Third-party software, fonts, stock assets, plugins and services remain subject to their own licences and terms.

8. Third-party services and hosting

Domains, hosting, payment gateways, analytics platforms, plugins, APIs, email providers, app stores and other third-party services are outside AB OUTREACH’s direct control. Their availability, pricing, policies, security and functionality may change. Third-party fees are separate unless expressly included in the project scope. AB OUTREACH does not guarantee uninterrupted availability of third-party services.

9. Performance, SEO and business results

AB OUTREACH builds websites for presentation, usability and agreed functionality. No guarantee is made that a website will produce a particular number of leads, sales, rankings, traffic, conversions, revenue or other business result. SEO work, where included, is an optimisation service and not a promise of a specific search-engine position.

10. Security and backups

Reasonable development practices may be used, but no internet-connected system can be guaranteed to be completely secure or continuously available. Unless expressly included in writing, ongoing security monitoring, backups, hosting administration, updates and maintenance are not part of the project after handover.

11. Confidentiality

Each party should protect non-public business, technical and commercial information received from the other party and use it only for the relevant project, subject to information that is already public, independently developed, lawfully obtained from another source or required to be disclosed by law.

12. Client warranties and indemnity

The client represents that it has the necessary rights to all content, trademarks, images, data, software and instructions it supplies. To the extent permitted by applicable law and the project agreement, the client is responsible for claims arising from materials or instructions supplied by the client that infringe another person’s rights or violate applicable law.

13. Limitation of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, AB OUTREACH will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential loss, loss of profits, loss of revenue, loss of goodwill or loss of data arising from the services. Any aggregate liability will be limited to the amount actually paid to AB OUTREACH for the specific project giving rise to the claim, unless the applicable written agreement or mandatory law requires a different result. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

14. Force majeure

AB OUTREACH is not responsible for failure or delay caused by events beyond reasonable control, including serious internet or infrastructure outages, natural disasters, war, civil unrest, government action, labour disruption, cyber incidents affecting relevant providers, epidemics, or failures of essential third-party platforms.

15. International clients and applicable law

AB OUTREACH is based in India. Unless a signed project agreement expressly provides otherwise, these terms and the contractual relationship are governed by the laws of India, subject to mandatory laws that cannot legally be excluded. Where a client is located outside India, the parties intend to comply with mandatory laws applicable to that transaction, including applicable consumer, privacy, tax and electronic-commerce requirements in the client’s jurisdiction. These terms do not claim to replace any mandatory local law.

16. Disputes and jurisdiction

The parties should first attempt in good faith to resolve project disputes through written discussion. Unless a signed project agreement states otherwise, disputes are subject to the dispute-resolution mechanism and jurisdiction specified by the applicable project agreement; in the absence of such a provision, courts with appropriate jurisdiction in Haryana, India will have jurisdiction, subject to applicable law. For international commercial projects, the parties may instead agree in writing to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, with the seat, language, procedure and arbitrator stated in the project agreement.

17. Electronic records and acceptance

Electronic communications, approvals and records may be used for project administration and contract formation to the extent permitted by applicable law. The Information Technology Act, 2000 recognises electronic records and provides for validity of electronic contracts in section 10A. Project-specific signed proposals, quotations, statements of work and invoices remain the preferred record of commercial scope and payment terms.

18. Changes to these website terms

AB OUTREACH may update these website terms when necessary. The version applicable to a particular project is the version incorporated into the project agreement or otherwise accepted for that project. Material project-specific terms should not be changed retroactively without agreement.

Privacy Notice

AB OUTREACH · PRIVACY · PERSONAL DATA
This notice is written for an India-based digital services business that may work internationally. The exact legal obligations depend on the people, data, services and countries involved.

1. What we collect

When you contact AB OUTREACH through this website, you may provide your name, email address, phone or WhatsApp number, business name, budget information and project details. We collect only information reasonably needed to respond to an enquiry and provide or discuss services.

2. How information is used

Information may be used to respond to enquiries, prepare proposals, communicate about projects, provide services, maintain business records, process payments and comply with legal obligations.

3. Email-based enquiry form

The current website form opens the visitor’s email application and prepares an enquiry addressed to AB OUTREACH. The website itself is not a server-side form processor. Once an email is sent, the information is handled through email and other service providers used by AB OUTREACH.

4. Sharing and service providers

Information may be shared with service providers where reasonably necessary to operate the business, such as email, hosting, domain, payment, analytics or project-management providers, or where disclosure is required by law.

5. International transfers

Because AB OUTREACH may work with clients and service providers in different countries, information may be processed or transferred across borders. Where privacy law applies, AB OUTREACH will use the safeguards required by that law for relevant transfers.

6. India privacy framework

For processing covered by Indian data-protection law, AB OUTREACH intends to handle personal data in accordance with applicable requirements of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and rules or notifications in force for the relevant processing. The DPDP Rules, 2025 were notified by the Government of India with staged commencement dates.

7. Other jurisdictions

If a client or visitor is protected by a foreign privacy regime such as the GDPR/UK GDPR or another applicable local data-protection law, additional rights, notices, contractual terms or transfer safeguards may apply depending on the facts of the relationship. AB OUTREACH does not claim that one website notice alone satisfies every country-specific requirement.

8. Retention and requests

Information is retained only as reasonably necessary for business, contractual, accounting, tax, dispute-resolution or legal purposes. Privacy requests can be sent to amritbehl01@gmail.com. Identity or other information may be requested where necessary to process a request lawfully.

9. Security

Reasonable administrative and technical measures are used for information under AB OUTREACH’s control, but no online system can be guaranteed completely secure.

10. Contact

For privacy questions or requests: amritbehl01@gmail.com
